LaunchId.description: A launch: one process lifetime of a thread.

ThreadId.description: A thread: one agent conversation across all its launches.

assume_dead.description:
The owner's assertion that the exited launch `expected_launch_id` has ended
(`docs/design/supervisor-recovery.md` §2.5): an owner token only, with
`expected_launch_id`. Omitted when false, so a plain stop keeps its canonical form.

expected_launch_id.description: When given, the current launch must be this one (`launch_changed` otherwise).
